01 — ABOUT HIM

Meet Luke ♡

A few little facts about the person behind the smile.

His Story ☁️

Luke Peemsan Sotangkur (ลูค ภีมสรรค์ โสตางกูร) is a Thai actor under GMMTV. Born on 15 January 2004, he has continued to grow through acting projects and new experiences. This fan-made page is a small celebration of his work and journey.
